disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Flawless (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). The 125,000-standing purchase is then farmed on top; Flawless's bar holds 132,000, enough to bank it.

conditions: The free item you pick at Flawless can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Tigris is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 12 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: Buy everything else you want from New Loka before switching pledges; standing drains once you help Suda.
